scripts.text:
[Exhausted Fairy]
Wait, don't come any closer. I can't stand your smell, it makes me feel dizzy.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的妖精]
等等，别靠过来。我受不了你的气味，闻起来让我头晕。

scripts.text:
[Kalua]
You don't look sophisticated, but I think you are better than those uncivilized guys who are around the snowfield.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢阿]
你看起来并不精致，但我认为你比雪原上那些粗野的家伙强多了。

[Flowa]
No offense, I was not looking at you with sympathy.
I just wondered how you could walk with that heavy body...
scripts.translation:
[芙萝娃]
别误会，我并不是在同情你。
我只是好奇，你那么重的身体是怎么走路的...

[Fairy]
It is shame that I have to
cope with those fat beasts.
I am just too delicate to fight with them.
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
不得不和那些肥硕的野兽打交道，真是丢脸。
我太娇弱了，根本没法和它们战斗。

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
Huh? You are a human.
You are better than those fat Saphas, but still you are not a beautiful thing also.
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
咦？你是人类。
你比那些肥胖的萨法强，但你也算不上什么美丽的东西。

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
How did you find this wonderful place?
This is a sophisticated place.
I don't think you can be here with us.
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
你是怎么找到这个美妙地方的？
这里是个精致的地方。
我觉得你不适合和我们待在一起。

[Fairy]
Lalalalal~Lala~Lalala~
Let's sing a song~!
My voice is so fantastic!
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
啦啦啦啦~啦啦~啦啦啦~
我们来唱歌吧~！
我的歌声太美妙了！

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
Don't even think about getting close to me!
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
别想靠近我！

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
This land was such a waste land.
It was extremely cold and
nothing could live here.
but, once we inhabited this place, it has been changing day by day.
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
这片土地曾经是荒地。
这里极其寒冷，
没有任何生物能在此生存。
但自从我们居住在这里，它每天都在发生变化。

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
Now, all the problems are gone.
Except those ugly fat Saphas.
How can we be rid of those things?
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
现在，所有的问题都解决了。
除了那些丑陋肥胖的萨法。
我们要怎样才能摆脱它们？

Ah-Ha, I am so stunning.
scripts.translation:
[妖精]

scripts.translation:
[妖精]

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
Hey, you~! Human! How did you find us?
What does your human world look like?
Is it fun to be there?
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
嘿，你~！人类！你是怎么找到我们的？
你们人类的世界是什么样的？
在那里生活有趣吗？

Don't talk to me. What do you want?
I know you will blame something on me right?
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
别跟我说话。你想干什么？
我知道你马上就会把责任推到我头上，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
I don't want to listen to other people...
I am perfect as I am!
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
我不想听别人说...
我现在的样子就是最完美的！

Listen carefully and learn more!
Let's sing and dance!
You can be part of us!
Shake your hips!
Wow~Woo~Wow~
Dance~!
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
仔细听，多学一点！
让我们唱歌跳舞吧！
你也可以加入我们！
扭动你的臀部！
哇~呜~哇~
跳舞~！

[Fairy]
I don't want to touch them at all.
But they are ruining my Yggdrasilberries.
I can't stand it anymore!
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
我完全不想碰它们。
但它们正在毁掉我的世界树浆果。
我再也受不了了！

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
Fighting is not my thing...
But for our glory, I will fight!
They should feel honored to be battling with us!
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
打架不是我的强项...
但为了我们的荣耀，我会战斗！
能与我们交手，它们应该感到荣幸！

[Fairy]
Hu...feel sleepy.
I am so bored. I have nothing to do.
Even my friends are fighting with those giants, but it is not really my job to help them.
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
呼...好困。
我好无聊，没事可做。
虽然我的朋友正在和那些巨人战斗，但帮它们并不是我的职责。

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
I better check my make-up
in the dressing room.
Or should I get more beauty sleep?
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
我最好去更衣室检查一下妆容。
还是说，我应该再睡个美容觉？

Flying in the sky is not easy.
But it is better than a walk on the ground.
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
在天空中飞翔并不容易。
但这比在地面上行走要好多了。

scripts.text:
[Fairy]
Are you a human? Poor thing...
You can't have these beautiful wings?
Pathetic lives.
It is obvious that we are the only ones who are blessed.
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
你是人类吗？可怜的家伙...
你不可能拥有这样美丽的翅膀吧？
可悲的生命。
很明显，只有我们是被祝福的。

Neatness, tidiness and cleanness!
Those are the words.
that can describe us!
Others are so dirty and messy!
scripts.translation:
[妖精]
整洁、有序、干净！
这就是形容我们的词语！
其他人都是那么肮脏和杂乱！

[Security Officer]
This is the underground prison of Splendide.
Those who are guilty and prisoners are detained here.
scripts.translation:
[安保人员]

有罪的人和囚犯都被关押在这里。

scripts.text:
[Security Officer]
If you do something suspicious, you must be detained here too, so you'd better to be careful!
scripts.translation:
[安保人员]
如果你做了什么可疑的事，你也必须被关押在这里，所以最好小心点！

If you make too much noise, the prisoners will cause trouble. So try to keep quiet at all times.

[Voice from another side]
Sir, Please!!!
How can I communicate secretly with Manuk!!
I'm innocent. Please.
scripts.translation:

先生，求求您了！！！
我该如何秘密地与马努克联系！！
我是无辜的。求求您。

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
Hi~~ do you hear the beautiful music coming from afar~?
scripts.translation:
[诗人 内尔]
嗨~~ 你听到从远处传来的美妙音乐了吗~？

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
Who, me...?
I am just a poet enjoying the ambience...
scripts.translation:
[诗人 内尔]
我？
我只是个享受氛围的诗人罢了...

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
I cam here the other day, requesting to take notes of this new world and they allow me to follow the adventurers here.
scripts.translation:
[诗人 内尔]
前几天我来到这里，请求记录这个新世界，他们允许我跟随这里的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
I became familiar with the Lapine.
It was quite awkward at first... Since I didn't knew their language.
But, one I started to play my instruments... they loved it.
scripts.translation:
[诗人 内尔]
我和拉皮尼熟悉了。
起初有点尴尬...因为我不懂它们的语言。
但当我开始演奏乐器时...它们很喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
They're fairies that know how to enjoy their lives..
How happy they are...
They are quite curious... I am honored to have met them...
scripts.translation:
[诗人 内尔]
它们是懂得享受生活的精灵...
它们真快乐...
它们很好奇...我很荣幸能遇见它们...

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
So do you want to listen to my playing?
scripts.translation:
[诗人 内尔]
那么，你想听听我的演奏吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: Not really.
scripts.translation: 不了

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
What song do you want??
scripts.translation:
[诗人 内尔]
你想听哪首曲子？

scripts.text: Poet of Bragie
scripts.translation: 布拉基的诗人

scripts.text: Chaos in Eternity
scripts.translation: 永恒的混沌

scripts.text: Sunset Assassin
scripts.translation: 夕阳刺客

scripts.text: Ring of Nibelungen
scripts.translation: 尼伯龙根的指环

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
Poet of Bragie!
You must have a keen ear.
scripts.translation:
[诗人 内尔]
布拉基的诗人！
你的耳朵真敏锐。

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
Chaos in Eternity...
This is a great piece but I wouldn't recommend it while dining...
scripts.translation:
[诗人 内尔]
永恒的混沌...
这是一首很棒的曲子，但不建议用餐时听...

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
Sunset Assassin!
Do you like Assassins?
This song tells of a legendary Assassin Cross that lived in the desert.
scripts.translation:
[诗人 内尔]
夕阳刺客！
你喜欢刺客吗？
这首歌讲述了一位生活在沙漠中的传奇十字刺客。

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
Ring of Nibelungen...
This song has quite an interesting story~
scripts.translation:
[诗人 内尔]
尼伯龙根的指环...
这首歌的故事很有趣~

scripts.translation: ^4d4dff洛基害怕失去控制，将可怜的阿尔贝里希变成了蛙王。

scripts.output: ^4d4dff阿尔贝里希用最后的呼吸发誓，他珍爱的指环将诅咒它的持有者，直至死亡。^000000
scripts.text: ^4d4dff Alberich swears with the last of his breath, that his treasured ring will curse it's wearer till death.

scripts.output: ^4d4dff持有者将永远被洛基的嫉妒所诅咒。^000000
scripts.text: ^4d4dff Forever will the bearer be, cursed with Rocky's jealousy.

[Poet Nell]
Why not?
Why would you stare at me like that if you didn't want to listen to my playing
scripts.translation:
[诗人 内尔]
为什么？
如果你不想听我演奏，
为什么那样盯着我看？

scripts.text: You look like someone I know.
scripts.translation: 你看起来像我认识的人。

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
Eh?
No way!
Maybe you're confused..!
scripts.translation:
[诗人 内尔]
诶？
不可能吧！
也许是你认错人了..!

scripts.text:
[Poet Nell]
Yes, I look quite common...
But I doubt we've ever met before.
scripts.translation:
[诗人 内尔]
是的，我看起来确实很普通...
但我怀疑我们以前从未见过。

scripts.text: - Nell seems embarrassed, then starts playing very complicated music -
scripts.translation: - 内尔似乎有些尴尬，然后开始演奏非常复杂的乐曲 -

scripts.text:
[Resting Laphine]
The poet on the stage is mysterious.
The moment you came here...
He arrived and started playing music.
scripts.translation:
[休息的拉菲尼]
舞台上的诗人很神秘。
就在你来到这里的时候...
他出现了并开始演奏音乐。

scripts.text:
[Resting Laphine]
This is music from your country yes?
I think it sounds great.
scripts.translation:
[休息的拉菲尼]
这是来自你国家的音乐吗？
我觉得听起来很棒。

scripts.text:
[Resting Laphine]
IyazLarsSe Or An.
marLoOsa Yee NeiBur
Rinisehrnea Mu...?
scripts.translation:
[休息的拉菲尼]
IyazLarsSe Or An.
marLoOsa Yee NeiBur
Rinisehrnea Mu...?

scripts.text: - He is nodding his head to the sound of the music -
scripts.translation: - 他随着音乐声点头 -

scripts.text:
[Resting Laphine]
Do you know how to play a similar sound?
This tone is unbelievable.
scripts.translation:
[休息的拉菲尼]
你知道如何演奏类似的声音吗？
这个音调令人难以置信。

scripts.text: - He is nodding his head to the sound of the music -
scripts.translation: - 他随着音乐声点头 -

scripts.text:
[Resting Laphine]
GothTingNoth Di~ nar..
DiebIyazNud Yu FarAn
nesFarDor U ~
scripts.translation:
[休息的拉菲尼]
GothTingNoth Di~ nar..
DiebIyazNud Yu FarAn
nesFarDor U ~

scripts.text:
[Dining Laphine]
I got bored eating home cooked food.
The only thing that keeps me coming here is fruit soup...
scripts.translation:
[用餐的拉菲尼]
吃家常菜让我感到无聊。
唯一让我来这里的原因就是水果汤...

scripts.text:
[Dining Laphine]
Hey you!
Why are you staring at me eating dinner?
scripts.translation:
[用餐的拉菲尼]
嘿，你！
为什么盯着我看我吃晚餐？

scripts.text:
[Dining Laphine]
NothFarLu Ra...? 
RuffYur..!
scripts.translation:
[用餐的拉菲尼]
NothFarLu Ra...? 
RuffYur..!

scripts.text: - He is giving me a odd stare as he eats his dinner -
scripts.translation: - 他一边吃晚餐一边用奇怪的眼神盯着我 -

scripts.text:
[Laphine taking notes]
We are quite impressed by the poet.
We Laphine love music as well.
I never imagined that I would ever hear such exotic music.
scripts.translation:
[做笔记的拉菲尼]
我们对这位诗人印象深刻。
我们拉菲尼人也热爱音乐。
我从未想过能听到如此异域风情的音乐。

scripts.text:
[Laphine taking notes]
I want to study music someday.
I plan to write much about the study of instruments and music
scripts.translation:
[做笔记的拉菲尼]
我想有一天研究音乐。
我计划撰写许多关于乐器和音乐研究的著作。

scripts.text:
[Laphine taking notes]
Someday you should listen to mu people's music.
scripts.translation:
[做笔记的拉菲尼]
总有一天你应该听听我们拉菲尼人的音乐。

scripts.text:
[Laphine taking notes]
TiTalLars Ur tasThorNoth O AnImanWha.
FusLuRuff..... Mu TingLuAla Yee AnmanAndu
scripts.translation:
[做笔记的拉菲尼]
TiTalLars Ur tasThorNoth O AnImanWha.
FusLuRuff..... Mu TingLuAla Yee AnmanAndu

scripts.text: - He seems frustrated that you don't understand him -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎很沮丧，因为你听不懂他的话 -

scripts.text: - He is almost sleeping but he is still managing to hold a cup with a drink in it. He must be really tired-
scripts.translation: - 他几乎睡着了，但手里还紧紧握着一杯饮料。他一定累坏了 -

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
You are a stranger here, aren't you?
I am watching him to prevent anything bad from happening.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
你是这里的陌生人，对吧？
我盯着他，以防发生什么意外。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
Definitely you are involved.
The upper side people allow you to pass here...
But nobody knows what's going to happen in this battlefield.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
你肯定与此事有关。
上面的人允许你通过这里...
但谁也不知道这片战场会发生什么。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
Anyway, what's that instrument over there?
We have a similar one...
But it sounds totally different.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
总之，那边那个乐器是什么？
我们也有类似的...
但听起来完全不一样。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
FusVohlAnu Ur Lon.
LoUdenFar Ha Dormaur?
...marAmanYur Mu.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
FusVohlAnu Ur Lon.
LoUdenFar Ha Dormaur?
...marAmanYur Mu.

scripts.text: -The Laphine Soldier wants to tell you something, but just stops talking as you give him a blank stare -
scripts.translation: - 拉菲尼士兵想告诉你些什么，但当你一脸茫然地看着他时，他就闭嘴了 -

scripts.text:
[Laphine Staff]
Hm, what's up?
I'm sorry, but we don't sell food to strangers.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼职员]
嗯，怎么了？
抱歉，我们不向陌生人出售食物。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Staff]
You guys also need to be careful of food here.
Food is scarce here.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼职员]
你们在这里也要小心食物。
这里的食物很紧缺。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Staff]
You're going to have to find food somewhere else.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼职员]
你们得去别的地方找食物了。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Staff]
VeldAnoWeh Or 
TurWos
......ah...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼职员]
VeldAnoWeh Or 
TurWos
......啊...

scripts.text: - You just grin and smile. It's frustrating not to be able to understand their language. -
scripts.translation: - 你只是咧嘴一笑。听不懂他们的语言真让人沮丧。 -

scripts.text:
[Laphine Staff]
his camp serves a military purpose. But we also have a need for bars.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼职员]
他的营地有军事用途。但我们也需要酒吧。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Staff]
How else can a soldier release stress if not through drinking...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼职员]
士兵如果不喝酒，还能怎么释放压力呢...

scripts.text:
[Laphine Staff]
We are here to support the laphine soldier by giving good drinks and entertainment.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼职员]
我们在这里为拉菲尼士兵提供支持，提供美酒和娱乐。

scripts.text:

NorVerNuff Ee Re!
remuDurOdes Mu AshFus~!
OdesTalWeh Ur???
scripts.translation:

Are there any new supplies?
scripts.translation:
[高阶士兵]
有新到的补给品吗？

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
This sword just arrived...
This is inspired by stars, and we tested it by cutting the thread floating over the water.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
这把剑刚到...
它的设计灵感来自星星，我们曾用它切断漂浮在水面上的丝线来测试。

scripts.text:
[High-Ranked Soldier]
Hmm, we rarely used swords. But it looks great as a decoration.
scripts.translation:
[高阶士兵]
嗯，我们很少用剑。但作为装饰品看起来很不错。

scripts.text: - Seems their busy talking about weapons -
scripts.translation: - 他们似乎在谈论武器 -
